project_type: Static Three.js 3D driving sandbox. Vanilla ES modules, no build step, no package.json. index.html loads Three.js v0.160.0 from a CDN through an import map. Serve the folder over HTTP to run it.
build_system: None. Open via a static server (npx serve . or python -m http.server). Node v20.18.0 is available for syntax checks only.
test_framework: None in the repo. Verification uses a Node harness in $env:TEMP\furn-check\ (created by FEAT-001). It copies src, stubs the 'three' package with a Proxy module, runs buildEnvironment, buildTown, addRoadEdges and the furniture layout on the real town, and checks the placement rules.
test_command: node $env:TEMP\furn-check\check.mjs   (creates and refreshes the copy of src first; then node --check each changed .js inside the copy)
verification_instructions: 1) Run check.mjs; it must exit 0 and report zero violations. 2) It compares lot JSON and obstacle count with baseline.json captured before any edit; these must match unless a feature says otherwise. 3) Parse check: node --check on each changed .js file in the harness copy. 4) Visual checks by a person in the browser: traffic light heads face down, furniture sits on sidewalks, no furniture on the road or in parking bays.
environment_constraints: Windows, PowerShell. Node v20.18.0. Do not run git commit or git push. Do not switch or create branches. No worktree. Do not read third-party library source (Three.js internals). Git index already holds staged changes from other tasks (src/world/building/facade.js, src/world/building/town.js, .agents/tasks/facade-details/, .agents/tasks/road-sidewalk-improvements/); do not stage, unstage or edit them.
contribution_requirements: Personal steering: short doc comments with <summary> and <paramref> where parameters are named; one-line inline comments at most; early returns over deep nesting; no migration files; do not commit or push; use English; only run tests for major updates (this task is major, so the harness runs). The repo steering file .kiro/steering/backend-code-review.md does not exist.
key_patterns: Instanced rendering: addInstanced(scene, geometry, mat, matrices) and matrixAt(x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, rotY) in src/core/primitives.js. Materials cached by color in tree.js and bush.js. Street geometry: STREETS entries {alongX, offset, halfWidth} in src/core/world.js; for alongX true the street runs along X at z = offset. Road plus sidewalk rectangles are ZONES. Parking lots (lots array from buildTown) start at halfWidth + SIDEWALK_WIDTH and extend away from the street. Collision obstacles are pushed to the obstacles array as {box:{minX,maxX,minZ,maxZ}} or {x,z,r}. Placement and clearance tests use rectsOverlap, inRect and grow from src/core/world.js. Random: rand() in world.js is one shared seeded generator; new placement code must use its own generator so the town, trees and bushes keep their layout. Sidewalk lamp, manhole and traffic light placement is in src/world/environment.js (addStreetLamps, addManholes, addTrafficLights, junctionLights).
directory_structure: src/core: shared constants, primitives, random and obstacles (world.js, primitives.js). src/world: environment.js (ground, roads, sidewalks, markings, lamps, traffic lights, barriers), tree.js, bush.js, and building/ (town.js lot layout, facade.js doors and signs, models.js, park.js, distributor.js). src/vehicles: vehicle models. src/game: missions and markers. src/main.js: renderer, physics, and world build order. .agents/tasks: plans and reviews for each task.
